events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential implications for global markets and economies. The US and its allies are considering further military action, while Iran has vowed to retaliate. This escalation could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to increased volatility in global markets, particularly in emerging markets. A short position in EEM could be beneficial, while a long position in gold could provide a safe-haven bid.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and global market volatility

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or global market volatility decreases

gains.extendedNote: If global market volatility increases significantly

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve is considering an interest rate hike to combat inflation. This could lead to increased volatility in bond markets and impact the US economy.
events.reasoning: An interest rate hike could lead to increased volatility in bond markets, making a short position in TLT beneficial. A long position in SPY could provide a hedge against potential economic growth.

timeFrame.note: Monitor inflation data and Fed statements

events.exitStrategy: Exit when interest rates stabilize or inflation data improves

events.title: Nvidia AI Spending

events.reasoning: Increased AI spending by Nvidia could lead to increased demand for its products, making a long position in NVDA beneficial. Rotating from AMD to NVDA could also be beneficial.
